label: Node.js API

structure.rule: no business logic; parse, validate, delegate, map errors
the only module that imports the database driver

notes: Every request body and query is validated at the route boundary; services receive typed input only.
Errors map to HTTP status codes in one place; handlers never leak stack traces or driver messages.
Configuration comes from the environment; the process fails fast on a missing required variable.
`npx eslint .` clean and `npm test` green before a task is done; `npx tsc --noEmit` applies when the project is TypeScript.
